name: Account Verification
definition: Information to be verified to assess whether an account is valid.

Context.name: Context
Context.definition: Context of the party verification process.

AccountOwnerType.name: Account Owner Type
AccountOwnerType.definition: Specifies the type of account ownership.

Party.name: Party
Party.definition: Details of the party that will be verified.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

PaymentIdentification.name: Payment Identification
PaymentIdentification.definition: Specifies the different identifications associated with a payment transaction.

RequestingVerificationService.name: Requesting Verification Service
RequestingVerificationService.definition: Identification of the verification service assigned by the Requesting Agent.

Document.name: Document
Document.definition: General information that unambiguously identifies a document, such as identification number and issue date time.

MatchedPostalAddress.name: Matched Postal Address
MatchedPostalAddress.definition: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services.
